description_en: Deletes a live stream transcoding template
name: DeleteLiveTranscodeTemplate

parameters.description_en: The template ID. To obtain the template ID, log on to the [Intelligent Media Services (IMS) console](https://ice.console.aliyun.com/summary), choose Real-time Media Processing > Template Management, and then click the Transcoding tab. Alternatively, find the ID from the response parameters of the [CreateLiveTranscodeTemplate](~~449217~~) operation.
